steps.title: Beat the wet ingredients
steps.body: Beat together **2 cups sugar**, **4 eggs**, **1½ cups oil** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add, and mix in **2 cups flour**, **2 tsp soda**, **2 tsp cinnamon** and **1 tsp salt**.

steps.title: Stir in the add-ins
steps.body: Stir in, just until mixed: **3 cups grated carrots**, raisins, walnuts and coconut.

steps.title: Bake the cake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F in a greased pan.

steps.title: Make the frosting
steps.body: Make the cream cheese frosting by creaming together **8 oz cream cheese**, softened, **⅔ cup butter**, **1 tsp vanilla** and **4–6 cups powdered sugar**.

steps.title: Frost and sprinkle
steps.body: Top with the frosting and sprinkle with nutmeg.
